contexts.text: Policy documents display a version and effective date. Unless a new version explicitly says otherwise, the version in force on the triggering event date controls. Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and charged a 15% opened-device restocking fee. Return Policy version 2.0 applies to orders placed on or after September 1, 2026. It allows 30 days unopened, 14 days opened, and charges 10%. The 45-day OrbitPlus unopened-device benefit was introduced with version 2.0. Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership. For version 2.0 orders, the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date.
